reason: The corrected S-Norm evaluation harness scores pre-segmented Kathbath trial files with file-level embeddings and does not emit frame/window cluster labels or target-speaker diarisation accuracy. It therefore cannot identify an evidence-backed replacement for the diarisation clustering threshold.
finding: No threshold change recommended from the available artifacts.
needed_next_artifact: A diarisation-specific validation set with multi-speaker audio, target-speaker labels, per-window cluster assignments, and target-speaker extraction success/failure by telephone condition/accent cohort.
